description: Additive F1S template: merge the new evidence fields into a reviewed host instance, preserving existing GLM evidence, mount UUIDs and lifecycle paths
notes: No acquisition or live authentication completion is asserted; incomplete evidence must fail start before Docker activation.
Merge into the existing protected instance; never replace its identity, mount UUIDs, GLM evidence or state/lock/recovery paths blindly.
Supply exact independently verified mount UUIDs and the local inspected pinned image and flag evidence.
Record launcher_sha256 only after installation from reviewed merged source; the manager compares installed bytes, source bytes and this evidence.
Set auth_gate_passed only after F1D actual pinned-image sentinel launch/setup tests, including final auth layers, diagnostics and failed warmup cleanup; synthetic source tests alone do not qualify.

Write the separate completion manifest only after all 48 pinned artifacts pass SHA256 verification and index/config consistency checks. Never edit the immutable expected F1A manifest to indicate completion.
Keep the existing mode0600 regular nonsymlink API key unchanged; exact 1..4096 printable ASCII bytes with no whitespace or newline.
